# Gistly

> > AI-powered YouTube summarizer and content analysis tool that transforms video content into instant summaries using ChatGPT.

Gistly is a free AI tool that leverages ChatGPT and GPT-4 to summarize YouTube videos, extract transcripts, and generate FAQ content. Available as both a web platform and Chrome browser extension, it helps creators and viewers save time by instantly converting video content into actionable summaries.
